corrected_probe.observation_format: JSON parsed from Code Editor GRID_PROBE console lines

value.source_B11_transform:
PARAM_MT["Affine", 
 PARAMETER["num_row", 3], 
 PARAMETER["num_col", 3], 
 PARAMETER["elt_0_0", 20.0], 
 PARAMETER["elt_0_2", 699960.0], 
 PARAMETER["elt_1_1", -20.0], 
 PARAMETER["elt_1_2", 5300040.0]]
value.source_B4_transform:
PARAM_MT["Affine", 
 PARAMETER["num_row", 3], 
 PARAMETER["num_col", 3], 
 PARAMETER["elt_0_0", 10.0], 
 PARAMETER["elt_0_2", 699960.0], 
 PARAMETER["elt_1_1", -10.0], 
 PARAMETER["elt_1_2", 5300040.0]]

interpretation: The raster affine matches the production projection call. Ground distances and areas differ from nominal projected units.
The impulse support matches integer disks in projected units at both tested latitudes. The annulus is not a latitude-invariant ground-distance buffer.
Resampling before versus after the median changes the sampled B8 value in this collection. This is a raw-band order diagnostic, not the frozen index-compositor A/B comparison.
Native B4 and B11 projection metadata are captured; full band-alignment and categorical-interpolation behavior remain untested.
corrected_probe.attempt_note: An intermediate run used Projection.atScale with a positive y axis. Its callbacks overlapped the next run. Final observations here were recaptured in a fresh Code Editor tab from the committed probe, with no earlier callbacks.
